about: Live check (mail-check): the owner said "yes" to the hub in the chat - the core did not count it, the session asked him itself, and after the "yes" on the page it came up and stood idle. Decision: `grant --for mN` referring to his word to the hub is the permission (it is checked that this is the owner's word to the hub and, since 18.11, that it names the tool: a bare "yes" is no yes to a risky tool, tests/test_hub_names_tool.py). While it waits for the "yes" the session's task says not to ask itself; once connected - "connected, continue", and the delegation is in work again.
